passages.text: Heritage railway station in Norfolk, England. Sheringham is a heritage railway station in Sheringham, Norfolk, England. It was once part of the Midland and Great Northern Joint Railway network between 1887 and 1967, when a new station was opened by British Rail c.200 metres (220 yd) eastwards. Since July 1975, it has served as the eastern terminus of the North Norfolk Railway. In March 2010, the link to the Network Rail system was reinstated.
